instrumentation_qualification.compared_order_rows: Executed observed inventory-row instances, including repeated diagnostics across generations; not unique historical orders or throughput.
instrumentation_qualification.inventory_comparisons: Executed complete FIFO/BBO comparisons: fresh imported seeds, each applied callback including the partial callback, each arrival diagnostic, each admitted EOF and each accepted candidate value.

limitations: This is bounded recomputation from authenticated retained local inputs, not a live venue retransmission implementation.
Two reserved attempts per case, at most one live generation and no reset, recovery checkpoint, reorder cache or packet fabrication.
Admission refusals occur before construction and do not test allocator exhaustion.
The stale-ordinal mutant demonstrates an incorrect denial reason and token-before-promotion boundary; successful unauthorised promotion is not claimed.
Repeated full-state comparisons do not add historical samples or prove arbitrary future streams.
No network availability, receipt-clock, latency, performance, queue eligibility, shadow-fill or strategy claim.
Per-case, per-arrival, lifetime and complete inventory records remain ignored; this publication contains aggregates and identities.

initial_independent_audit_scope_correcti.reason: The first independent evidence audit incorrectly required the order-book index-layout definition on generic mold.cpp. The corrected audit checks that ABI definition on actual L3 consumers (worker and book) and separately validates the generic transport flags. This correction changed only the metadata audit; original failure and source remain bound by the successful audit.

initial_verifier_failure.reason: The integer-only reader rejected a floating diagnostic value in a SHA-pinned historical metadata report. The targeted reader was corrected only for that retained diagnostic report.
